# The Astra Forge

> The Astra Forge (https://theastraforge.com/) is a Pakistan-based AI video editing agency serving US brands (primary market), plus the UK, Europe, Canada and Australia. It combines AI generation with human editing: 48-hour turnaround per video, pay-per-video pricing from $15, and a free sample edit for new clients.

## Services
- Talking-head video editing — YouTube videos, online courses, podcasts, webinars ($30/finished min): https://theastraforge.com/talking-head-video-editing/
- AI UGC video ads — AI-generated creator-style ads for e-commerce/DTC brands, Shopify and Amazon sellers: https://theastraforge.com/ai-ugc-video-ads/
- AI avatar / spokesperson videos — photorealistic AI presenter from your script, no filming needed ($50/finished min): https://theastraforge.com/ai-avatar-videos/
- Short-form video editing — Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts with hook-first pacing and animated captions ($15/short): https://theastraforge.com/short-form-video-editing/
- Podcast to Shorts — long episodes repurposed into high-retention vertical clips: https://theastraforge.com/podcast-to-shorts/
- Product videos and 3D product animation: https://theastraforge.com/product-video-animation/
- Explainer and demo videos for SaaS and startups: https://theastraforge.com/explainer-videos/
- Full service list: https://theastraforge.com/#services

## Pricing (USD)
- Pay per video: short-form $15/short, talking-head $30/min, AI avatar $50/min, course production $30/min
- Monthly retainers: Starter $199/mo (15 shorts), Growth $499/mo (30 shorts + 5 min talking-head), Brand $999/mo (50 shorts + 10 min talking-head + 5 min AI avatar) — pause or cancel anytime
- Course packages: Mini $799 (up to 30 min finished), Full $1,499 (up to 60 min finished)
- Details: https://theastraforge.com/#pricing

## Who we serve
Coaches and course creators, real estate agents, Shopify/DTC and e-commerce brands, restaurants, law firms, dentists and clinics, fitness coaches, SaaS companies, podcasters and YouTubers — primarily in the USA, also UK, Europe, Canada, Australia.
